source.title: WST Leader Announcement (November 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that Duncan Hobbs will become the new Leader of the WCA Software Team (WST). Duncan was already a Senior Member on the team.

Duncan was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of November 1, 2026.

<!-- break --> 
We thank Gregor Billing, who will remain as a Senior Member of WST, for his substantial contributions to the WCA as WST Leader since 2021, and wish Duncan the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Duncan was the only applicant. You can view his candidacy document [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BTssFqmTvAdTGAP9od1EDDusWSyQJcf4?usp=drive_link).

translation.title: WCA 软件组组长任命公告（2026 年 11 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴地宣布，Duncan Hobbs 将出任 WCA 软件组（WST）的新任组长。Duncan 此前已是该组的高级成员。

根据有关 WCA 委员会和工作组的[动议](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf)第 5 节规定的程序，WCA 董事会选定 Duncan，并投票通过了这项任命。任命自 2026 年 11 月 1 日起生效。

我们感谢 Gregor Billing 自 2021 年担任 WST 组长以来为 WCA 作出的重大贡献。他将继续担任 WST 的高级成员。我们也祝愿 Duncan 顺利履行新职责。

Duncan 是唯一的申请人。你可以[在此](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1BTssFqmTvAdTGAP9od1EDDusWSyQJcf4?usp=drive_link)查看他的候选申请材料。
